name: Nabari Anju
source:
[b]Lead Guitarist of [i]Lemonade Factory[/i][/b]

A girl who is a part-time job colleague of the [url=/c153631]protagonist[/url].
She can be cheeky, but her bright personality makes her hard to dislike.
For some reason, she tries to keep her private life secret.
